description: Select exactly three of six bonds, balancing synthetic yield score, covariance risk and closeness to a target total duration. Synthetic, normalized values; not market data or investment advice.
bit_order: bitstring character k (left to right) = variable index k; '101010' means A, C, E selected

objective.expression: E(x) = q * x^T Sigma x - mu^T x + A * (sum(x) - B)^2 + w * (d^T x - T)^2
objective.matrix_convention: x^T Sigma x uses the full symmetric matrix, so cross terms appear twice when expanded

qubo_convention.form: E(x) = sum_i a_i x_i + sum_{i<j} b_ij x_i x_j + c
qubo_convention.storage: linear a_i, upper-triangular pair coefficients b_ij (each pair stored once), constant c
